schema.description: A single point-of-sale purchase RECEIPT (retail or restaurant). DOC-TYPE / SCOPE RULE: if one file bundles MULTIPLE distinct receipts or transactions (e.g. a Lowe's email containing several purchases, each with its own 'Transaction #' and 'Order #'), extract ONLY the FIRST receipt — the one that appears FIRST in reading order (top of the document, earliest Order Date/time). Ignore all later receipts; do NOT merge line items, totals, or payments across receipts. A receipt is NOT an invoice: there is no bill-to customer, no due date, no PO terms.

address.description: Merchant street address as printed on the receipt header.

street.description: Street line (number + street name), e.g. '600 N CLARK', '729 BRIDGE STREET'. Null if the receipt prints no street address. Do NOT confuse with the merchant name line above it or the city/state line below it.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. 'IL', 'MA'. Null if absent. Do NOT confuse with the ZIP.

zip_code.description: Postal/ZIP code verbatim including leading zeros, e.g. '60610', '02191'. Null if absent.

merchant_name.description: The selling merchant / store brand printed at the top of the receipt. May appear as a logo word, a 'THANK YOU FOR CHOOSING <X>' line, or a legal entity name. Examples: 'MCDONALDS', 'GOLDEN CORRAL', "LOWE'S HOME CENTERS, LLC". Use the brand/legal name verbatim; strip a trailing store number (that goes in store_number). Do NOT confuse with a cardholder, server, or 'sold to' name.

store_number.description: The store/location identifier for this merchant outlet. Label aliases: 'Store#', 'Store #', a '#NNNN' suffix on the brand line (e.g. 'GOLDEN CORRAL #0938' -> '0938'), or 'MCDONALDS 6676'. Return digits only, verbatim including leading zeros. Do NOT confuse with Terminal #, Register/KS#, Transaction #, Order #, or MER# (merchant id). Null if no store number is printed.

merchant_address.description: The merchant's street address block from the receipt header. Null if the receipt prints no address at all (e.g. a receipt that shows only the brand name).

merchant_phone.description: Merchant phone number from the header, verbatim as printed (keep the format the receipt uses, e.g. '312-867-0455' or '(781) 340-5964'). Label aliases: 'TEL#', 'TEL', 'PHONE'. Null if not printed. Do NOT confuse with a card authorization code or transaction id.

transaction_date.description: The date the purchase/transaction occurred, normalized to ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Sources: a header date line ('Dec.08\'12 (Sat)' -> '2012-12-08'), 'Order Date : 01/21/26' -> '2026-01-21', or a 'MM/DD/YY' near the total ('02/27/15' -> '2015-02-27'). Interpret 2-digit years as 20YY. Do NOT confuse with an AuthTime date if it differs from the order date — prefer the Order/Transaction date. If only 'MM/DD' (no year) is printed, use the year from elsewhere on the same receipt; if truly absent, use the printed value's year.

transaction_time.description: Time of the transaction in 24-hour 'HH:MM' format. Sources: '(Sat) 00:34' -> '00:34', 'Order Date : 01/21/26 08:13:57' -> '08:13', '1:28p' -> '13:28'. Convert 12-hour am/pm to 24-hour. Null if no time is printed. Do NOT confuse with AuthTime (use the order/transaction time when both exist).

transaction_id.description: The primary transaction/receipt identifier for this purchase. Label aliases: 'Transaction #', 'Order #', 'F-NNNN' check id, 'Rec:' number, 'Order'. Prefer the value explicitly labeled 'Transaction #'; else the 'Order #'; else the check/receipt id printed nearest the items. Return the FULL printed token VERBATIM, including any leading letter prefix and hyphen and leading zeros (e.g. 'F-0298' -> 'F-0298', NOT '0298'; 'Transaction # : 11847985' -> '11847985'). Do NOT confuse with store_number, Terminal #, SEQ#, MER#, or the card authorization code. Null if none is printed.

line_items.description: The list of purchased line items, one entry per printed item row, in top-to-bottom reading order. Include ONLY real purchased items; EXCLUDE subtotal/tax/total rows, 'Invoice NNNN Subtotal' roll-up rows, 'Total # of items' lines, and survey/marketing text. For the multi-receipt scope rule above, include only the first receipt's items.

line_no.description: 1-based sequential position of this item in the printed item list (first item = 1, second = 2, ...). This is a positional ordinal assigned by reading order, NOT a value printed on the receipt. It is the identity_key for row alignment.

description.description: The item name/description exactly as printed on its row, e.g. 'MED VANILLA SHAKE', 'BIG MAC', 'PS 6-IN JR HACKSAW', 'SR LUNCH BUFFET', 'TEA'. Verbatim text minus the leading quantity and trailing price. Do NOT include the SKU/Item # (that is its own field).

quantity.description: Quantity purchased for this row. Sources: a leading QTY column ('5 MED VANILLA SHAKE' -> 5), or a '1 @ 8.98' unit line -> 1. If no quantity is printed for the row, default to 1. Do NOT confuse with unit_price or item_total.

unit_price.description: Price per single unit, populated ONLY when a per-unit price is explicitly printed SEPARATELY from the line total — e.g. the value after '@' in '1 @ 8.98' -> 8.98, or a dedicated per-unit price column. If the row shows only ONE price (the extended/line amount) with no explicit per-unit notation, that price is the item_total and unit_price MUST be null — even when quantity is 1 (do NOT copy the line total into unit_price, and do NOT compute it by dividing total by quantity). Do NOT confuse with item_total.

item_total.description: The extended amount charged for this row as printed in the line's price/TOTAL column, e.g. '5 MED VANILLA SHAKE  14.25' -> 14.25, 'PS 6-IN JR HACKSAW $ 8.98' -> 8.98. This is the per-row total, NOT the receipt subtotal/total. Do NOT confuse with unit_price (equal only when quantity is 1).

sku.description: The merchant item/SKU number for this row when printed, label alias 'Item #:' (e.g. 'Item #: 587724' -> '587724'). Return digits verbatim including leading zeros. Null when no item number is printed (most restaurant receipts). Do NOT confuse with line_no, store_number, or transaction_id.

subtotal.description: Pre-tax subtotal = sum of line item totals, as PRINTED. Label aliases: 'Subtotal', 'Sub Total', 'Sub Total :'. For multi-receipt files use the first receipt's subtotal. Do NOT confuse with 'Invoice NNNN Subtotal' roll-up duplicates (same value), with tax, or with total.

tax.description: Total sales tax charged, as PRINTED. Label aliases: 'Tax', 'Total Tax', 'Tax :'. Do NOT confuse with subtotal or total. Return the printed amount (0 only if the receipt prints a zero tax).

total.description: The grand total amount due/charged for the purchase, as PRINTED. Label aliases: 'Total', 'TOTAL', 'Eat-In Total', 'TOTAL :', 'TOTAL SALES'. Equals subtotal + tax. For multi-receipt files use the first receipt's total. Do NOT confuse with subtotal, tax, amount_paid/tendered (often equal), or a per-line item_total.

payment_method.description: The tender / card brand used to pay. Normalize to one of: 'VISA', 'MASTERCARD', 'AMEX', 'DISCOVER', 'DEBIT', 'CASH', 'GIFT_CARD', 'OTHER'. Sources: 'Payment: VISA ending in 3954' -> 'VISA', 'MASTERCARD' memo -> 'MASTERCARD', 'Debit SALE' / 'Cashless' debit -> 'DEBIT'. Null if the tender is not identifiable. Do NOT confuse with the card last-4 or auth code.

card_last4.description: The last four digits of the card account used, as a 4-character string. Sources: 'ACCOUNT# ************0093' -> '0093', 'VISA ending in 3954' -> '3954', a masked 'xxxxxxxxxxxxx5760' -> '5760'. Null if no card digits are printed (e.g. cash). Do NOT confuse with store_number, auth_code, or transaction_id.

auth_code.description: The card authorization/approval code for the payment, taken ONLY from a token EXPLICITLY labeled as such. Label aliases (one must be present): 'AUTHORIZATION CODE', 'AUTH CODE', 'AuthCD', 'Approval', 'Approval Code'. Return verbatim (may be alphanumeric, e.g. '861336', '05391D'). Return null if no explicitly-labeled authorization/approval code is printed. Do NOT pull a value from a 'Memo:' line, a 'Rec:' receipt number, REFID, SEQ#, or any unlabeled alphanumeric token. Do NOT confuse with card_last4 or transaction_id.

amount_paid.description: The amount actually tendered/charged to the payment method. Label aliases: 'AMT-TEND', 'Cashless', 'Payment: ... $X', 'TALLY', 'AMOUNT'. Usually equals total. Null if not separately printed. Do NOT confuse with 'Change', subtotal, or tax.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the receipt amounts. US receipts default to 'USD' (amounts shown with '$' or no symbol on a US merchant receipt). Infer from the merchant locale/currency symbol.
